title: Cut Claude Token Usage by 70% with This Free Tool
description:
Comment "TOKEN" and I'll send you the link.

Most people uploading PDFs to Claude are burning tokens for nothing, and Microsoft has a free fix.

A 20-page PDF burns up to 70,000 tokens before your first question. MarkItDown turns any file, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, into clean structured text.

Token usage drops up to 70%, and Claude answers better. Through its MCP server it auto-converts every file you upload.

#claudeai #aitools #aiproductivity #aitok #tokens
